function confirmAlert() {
    var triggerId = $j("#alertTrigger").val();
    var url = $j("#" + triggerId).attr("href");
    var lengthOfStay = $j("#lengthInAlert").val();

    if( lengthOfStay == null || lengthOfStay == "" ) {
        lengthOfStay = 1;
    }

    if( url.indexOf("lengthOfStay=") >= 0 ) {
        url = url.replace(new RegExp("lengthOfStay=[0-9]+"), "lengthOfStay=" + lengthOfStay);
    } else {
        url = raAddParamToUrl(url, "lengthOfStay", lengthOfStay);
    }
    javascript:document.location.href= url;
}

<div id='alertscontent' class='sectioncontent' style='display: none;'>
<div class='importantMemo'><p>Take advantage of the free shuttle service from Four Mile Creek to Old Fort Niagara and several points in between! Explore the Four Mile neighborhood for free on the Discover Niagara Shuttle and even catch a free ride to Niagara Falls! See <a href="https://www.discoverniagarashuttle.com/" target="_blank">www.discoverniagarashuttle.com</a> for more details including schedule, locations, and service alerts.</p>

<p><br /><font color="#D8001F"><b>PLEASE NOTE: The pavilion at Four Mile Creek State Park can only be reserved by campers currently camping at the park.</b></font></p>

<p><b>General Information:</b></p>
<ul class="bulletStyle">
    <li>Four Mile Creek offers YURTS! Check out these unique accommodations and reserve today!</li>
    <li>Not all site numbers are beside each other. Consult the park maps for location of adjacent sites.</li>
    <li>Quiet hours are from 10PM to 8AM and strictly enforced. </li>
    <li>Generator Hours are 9AM -11AM and 5PM - 9PM. Please be considerate of other campers.</li>
    <li>Campers must be 21 years of age or older to possess or consume alcohol.</li>
    <li>There is a camp store located at this park.</li>
</ul>

<p><br /><b>ATTENTION PET OWNERS:</b></p>
<ul class="bulletStyle">
    <li>Current proof of rabies inoculation is required at check-in (metal tags will not be accepted).</li>
    <li>At any time during your stay, pet owners may be required to provide proof of rabies inoculation upon request. Be sure to have this information available to present to park staff.</li>
    <li>Where pets are permitted, there is a maximum limit of 2 pets per site.</li>
    <li>Pets must be on a leash no longer than 6ft and under control at all times.</li>
    <li>Do not leave pets unattended and always clean up after them.</li>
    <li>Pet owners/permit holders are liable for any damage, personal injury, or nuisance caused by the pet.</li>
    <li>There is a pooper-scooper law in effect to help keep the park clean.</li>
    <li>Please do not tie your pet to trees, shrubs, electrical poles, or other stationary objects.</li>
</ul>

<p><br /><b>Looking to reserve for just 1 night?</b> If you make your reservation within 7 days of your arrival you can book a 1-night stay online or through the Call Center. This applies to campsites only.</p>
<p><br /><b>LENGTH OF STAY: </b>A camping party and their equipment may occupy a site for a maximum of 14 continuous nights. After which, the camping party and equipment must leave the site and facility for 48 hours before registering again for another site.</p>

<p><br /><b>Please Note:</b> To ensure fairness for all NY customers, any reservation with departure dates outside the 9-month Maximum Window cannot be changed or cancelled until 18 days after the reservation was made.</p>

<p><br /><b><a href="https://parks.ny.gov/camping/things-to-know.aspx">OPRHP General Camping Rules, Information, and Cancellation Policy</a></b></p></div></div></div></div>

<div id='overviewContainer' class='sectioncontainer mb14'><a  name='overviewsection'  id='overviewsection_a'   ></a>
<div class='sectiontitle' role='button' tabindex='0' aria-label='Overview' aria-expanded='false'>Overview
<div class='sectionexpand'></div>
<div id='overview_sr_announcer' class='sr-only' aria-live='polite'></div></div>
<div id='overviewcontent' class='sectioncontent'>
<div>
<div class='h3'>Description</div><p ><b><font color="black">Explore all there is to do in Niagara Falls USA without needing a vehicle! </font></b><font>Check out the Discover Niagara Shuttle featuring free transportation to Niagara Falls State Park and more!  <a href=" https://www.discoverniagarashuttle.com/">Discover Niagara Shuttle</a> </font> <p> <br /> <font color="#D8001F"><b>PLEASE NOTE: The pavilion at Four Mile Creek State Park can only be reserved by campers currently camping at the park.<font color="#D8001F"><b> <br /></b></font></b></font></p><p> Just north of the mighty Niagara Falls, Four Mile Creek State Park's campsites sit near the shores of Lake Ontario. The marsh at the mouth of Four Mile Creek is home to fauna such as great blue herons and white-tailed deer, while flora, such as stunning white trillium and green brier, grow along its banks.</p></p>
<div class='h3'>Geography:</div><p >Four Mile Creek State Park is located on the shore of Lake Ontario, just 20 minutes north of Niagara Falls, in Niagara County.</p>
<div class='h3'>Recreation:</div><p >Considered a flagship facility, activities include biking, fishing, and camping.  Playgrounds are located in 100 Area, 200 area near the campstore.</p>
<div class='h3'>Facilities:</div><p >Campsites, some with electricity, are located near the shores of Lake Ontario and offer spectacular panoramic views.  Campsites have dumping stations and showers. The park also offers a camp store at Four Mile Creek, laundry facilities, a nature trail, picnic tables, a playground, and recreational activities led by NYS Park interpretive staff.</p>
<div class='h3'>Nearby Attractions:</div><p >Nearby state parks include Earl W. Brydges Artpark State Park, Wilson-Tuscarora State Park, Joseph Davis State Park, Niagara Falls State Park, and Fort Niagara State Park.</p></div></div></div>

	  //For now we're only validating rating. To be improved in the future to other fields as well (if mandatory flag exists)
	  if (!document.getElementById( 'ratingValue' ).value) {
		  document.getElementById( 'formError' ).style.display = "block";
          window.scrollTo(0, 0);
		  return false;
	  } else {
		  document.getElementById( 'formError' ).style.display = "none";
	  }
	  
	  
	var answers = {
		feedbackAns: [] 
	};
	
	var testData = $j('#feedbackContentDiv :input').serializeArray();
	$j.each( testData, function( i, field ) {
		var jsonData = {
				"questionId": field.name,
				"answer": field.value
			}
		answers.feedbackAns.push(jsonData);
    });
	var radioData = $j('#feedbackContentDiv .clicked');
	$j.each( radioData, function( i, field ) {
		var jsonRData = {
				"questionId": field.id.substr(0, field.id.indexOf('_')),
				"answer": field.id.substr(field.id.indexOf('_') + 1)
			}
		answers.feedbackAns.push(jsonRData);
    });
	
	
	var browser = (function(){
					    var ua= navigator.userAgent, tem,
					    M= ua.match(/(opera|chrome|safari|firefox|msie|trident(?=\/))\/?\s*(\d+)/i) || [];
					    if(/trident/i.test(M[1])){
					        tem=  /\brv[ :]+(\d+)/g.exec(ua) || [];
					        return 'IE '+(tem[1] || '');
					    }
					    if(M[1]=== 'Chrome'){
					        tem= ua.match(/\b(OPR|Edge)\/(\d+)/);
					        if(tem!= null) return tem.slice(1).join(' ').replace('OPR', 'Opera');
					    }
					    M= M[2]? [M[1], M[2]]: [navigator.appName, navigator.appVersion, '-?'];
					    if((tem= ua.match(/version\/(\d+)/i))!= null) M.splice(1, 1, tem[1]);
					    return M.join(' ');
					})();
	
	var feedbackOrderDetails = "";
	if (feedbackGroup == 'Checkout') {
		var orders = document.getElementsByName("feedbackOrderDetails");
		for (var x=0; x < orders.length; x++) {
			if (x > 0) {
				feedbackOrderDetails += ";";
			}
			feedbackOrderDetails += orders[x].value;
		}
	} 
	
    req = { action: "submitFeedback", feedbackAnswers: JSON.stringify(answers), url: window.location.href, browser: browser, feedbackGroup: feedbackGroup, feedbackOrderDetails : feedbackOrderDetails };
		$j.ajax({
	        url: "/ajax/FeedbackService?" + $j.param( req , true),
	        type: 'POST',
	        contentType: 'application/json',
	        success: function (response) {
	        	var popup = document.getElementsByClassName( 'feedbackDialog' );
	        	for (i = 0; i < popup.length; i++) {
	        		popup[i].style.top = "30%";
	        	}	        	
	        	document.getElementById( 'feedbackTitleDiv' ).style.display = "none";
	        	document.getElementById( 'feedbackContentDiv' ).style.display = "none";
	        	document.getElementById( 'feedbackButtonDiv' ).style.display = "none";
	        	document.getElementById( 'feedbackConfirmationDiv' ).style.display = "block";
        		window.scrollTo(0, 0);
	        },
	        error: function () {
	        	alert('Submission failed');
	        },
		    complete : function () {
	    	}
		}); 
  }
